name: Розвиток фігур (2)
description:
In the opening phase it is very important to mobilize pieces as actively as possible. Pieces are active if they have a lot of freedom of movement. In addition, pieces like to attack important targets. In this lesson, a particular developing move is significantly better than all other alternatives. 

Also note that castling is an important developing move. By castling, you activate your rook and bring your king to safety at the same time. 

What do you have to do? 

Develop a piece to an active square, or choose castling.

examples.text: The white knight on b1 wants to join the game. The best square is d2, because otherwise the knight would be in the way of the bishop. Moreover, white also wants to prevent the move ...d5-d4 from black.
The black king is in danger in the middle. Time to change that with 1...0-0!

texts: This develops the knight to an active square, while the pawn on e4 is now well defended.
Develop a piece and defend your center pawn.
